The plate is roughly 22 cm across, measured on the diagonal, so it is close to a side plate. The corn piece is about 100 px wide against a plate of about 340 px, which makes it roughly 6.5 cm across. It looks like a short corn cob segment about 3 to 4 cm long. A cob cross-section of that size has a volume of about 3.14 × 3.25² × 3.5 ≈ 116 cm³. Cob with kernels has a density near 0.6 to 0.7, which gives about 70 g, and I'll round to 65 g. Corn on the cob is about 90 kcal per 100 g.
